tourist_licence_phase_out.rule: Existing HUTs in stressed municipalities, Barcelona included, must obtain an urban-planning licence within 5 years or stop
tourist_licence_phase_out.law: Decret llei 3/2023, de 7 de novembre (DOGC 9036, 8 Nov 2023)
tourist_licence_phase_out.notes: Owners can request one extension of up to 5 more years (transitional provision 1.2). Ratified by the Catalan Parliament 20 Dec 2023. Appeal dismissed in full by STC 64/2025 (13 Mar 2025).

rent_cap.rule: New leases in stressed areas capped by the reference index
rent_cap.law: Ley 12/2023, de 24 de mayo; Resolució TER/800/2024 (Catalan zones)
rent_cap.notes: Zone valid 3 years from 16 Mar 2024. Extended in 118 municipalities by Resolució TER/3739/2026 (DOGC 19 Oct 2026); Barcelona is on the Generalitat's extension list. Extension end date not yet checked.

seasonal_rentals.rule: Seasonal lets not for holidays or leisure count as housing leases, so the stressed-zone rent cap applies to them
seasonal_rentals.notes: Adds art. 66 bis-ter to Llei 18/2007; room lets capped at the whole-flat maximum. Parts of the law (incl. art. 5) are challenged at the Constitutional Court (recurso 2415-2026, BOE-A-2026-13028); no ruling yet.

owners_veto.rule: Owners' associations can block new tourist lets by a 3/5 vote
owners_veto.law: Ley Orgánica 1/2025, de 2 de enero (BOE 3 Jan 2025), LPH art. 17.12
owners_veto.notes: Not retroactive: tourist lets already operating before 3 Apr 2025 can continue.

Generalitat de Catalunya - Preu mitjà del lloguer (Incasòl)

caveats: Prices are asking prices, not what guests paid; every Dec 2025 snapshot has no prices.
Only active listings (at least one open date) are counted; listings with no open dates jump to ~22-24% in every city's Sep 2026 snapshot.
Tourist-licence shares outside Catalonia are a lower bound: only confirmed regional codes are counted.
A missing or unmatched licence number is not proof of an illegal listing.
Airbnb's licence form changed: the 'Exempt - seasonal rental' option first appears in Jun 2026, so licence categories are not comparable across that date.
Comparisons show timing and differences, not causes.
